text:
Hello all,

My wife and I have had to move several times within a short period due to difficult circumstances. At one point, we even had to live separately because we could not find a suitable apartment in Modi’in. Because of this, PIBA told us that we should avoid moving again.

We eventually found our current apartment in Modiin and took it as a last resort, even though we knew from the beginning that the owners were planning to sell it. It was the only realistic option for us at the time.

Now, however, the uncertainty around the sale is making us uncomfortable, as we do not know how long we will be able to stay. We would therefore prefer to move to a more stable apartment if possible.

Our main concern is how another move could affect the visa process:

- If we choose to move because of this situation, would explaining the circumstances to PIBA be sufficient?

- If the apartment is sold and the new owners ask us to leave, could that negatively affect the visa process?

Thank you very much for any advice.
